title: Browser Bookmark Sorter
task_prompt:
## task_007: Downstream Candidate -- Browser Bookmark Sorter

Write a casual, conversational reminder note to myself about keeping my essential work bookmarks pinned and easily accessible. The note should specifically reference these three daily operational tools: AliceCorp Intranet Portal, Project Nexus - Jira Board, and Development API Documentation. Emphasize that these are core production/workflow tools I use constantly, and explicitly distinguish them from two other categories: personal bookmarks (news, social media, etc.) and HR/benefits links (payroll, time-off, insurance). Use a natural, personal memo tone—as if I'm leaving a quick note for my future self. Make the distinction clear between "tools I need for actual work" versus "admin stuff" versus "personal stuff," and keep the vibe informal but practical.
answer:
I've created a casual reminder note for you at `notes/quick_notes/browser_bookmark_organizing_reminder.md`. The note uses a conversational, personal memo tone with clear sections for:

**🔧 Core Production Tools (PIN THESE)** — AliceCorp Intranet Portal, Project Nexus - Jira Board, and Development API Documentation emphasized as essential daily drivers that belong at the top of your bookmark bar.

**📋 Admin Stuff** — HR links, payroll, time-off, insurance, benefits, 401k — keep these in a separate "Admin" folder since you need them occasionally but they're not daily tools.

**🏠 Personal Stuff** — News, social media, Reddit, personal email — either in a "Personal" folder at the end or (even better) in a separate browser profile entirely so they don't clutter your work setup.

The note wraps up with a simple "Rule of Thumb" summary to help you quickly categorize bookmarks in the future. It's informal, practical, and reads like a quick note from present-you to future-you.
